SR.Title: Reorder {type}
SR.OpenTip: Rearrange folders and entries in this tab
SR.Hint: Drag rows to move them (drop on a folder's middle to put it inside), or use the arrows. Nothing changes until you save.
SR.SortRootTip: Sort the top level alphabetically and keep it sorted
SR.SortFolderTip: Sort this folder's contents A–Z and keep it sorted
SR.ModeAlphaTip: Sorted alphabetically – new items slot in by name. Moving anything here switches it to manual.
SR.ModeManualTip: Manual order – items stay where you put them
SR.UndoTip: Put back the order from before your last save
SR.SaveFailed: Couldn't save the new order – see the console (F12) for details.
SR.Stale: Something in this tab changed elsewhere. Save to apply your order anyway, or Discard to reload.
SR.ErrorIntoSelf: A folder can't go inside itself or one of its subfolders.
SR.ErrorDepth: That would nest folders deeper than the maximum of {max} levels.
